name: Cartoon Character Maker - A Customizable Avatar Builder

captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a stylized, low-poly parametric avatar head resembling a customizable Mii character. It features a simplified head shape with blocky hair on top, thick rectangular hipster glasses, small round eyes looking slightly upwards, a triangular nose, and a wide-open agape mouth. Small ears are positioned on the sides of the head, and a subtle beard outline is integrated into the lower face geometry.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric, customizable 3D avatar head in OpenSCAD with adjustable facial features. The script should allow users to modify the face proportions, hair style, eye spacing and angle, nose shape, mouth expression, and optional accessories like hipster glasses, all controlled via top-level variables.
captions.factory: The avatar is constructed using a main module that combines the head shape, eyes, mouth, nose, ears, hair, beard, and glasses using a union operation. The basic head geometry is created by applying a hull operation over two spheres of different radii (rs and rc) positioned along the Z-axis. Features like the mouth are carved out using difference and intersection operations with cylindrical blanks, while facial features are placed symmetrically using for-loops with translation and rotation transforms.
